verdict.rationale: PayPal's Agent Toolkit explicitly exposes order and shipment-tracking access ('access orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details') via pre-built functions callable through MCP/LangChain/etc., plus create_order, pay_order and create_shipment tools, and webhooks can notify on order/shipment events. This gives an agent the plumbing to query post-purchase order status/tracking, but there's no dedicated 'get_order_status' or 'get_tracking' tool documented explicitly, and Store Sync/Agentic Commerce (the actual end-to-end consumer purchase flow) docs focus on cart/checkout creation with no explicit post-purchase tracking query capability shown for that path. Missing for 10: an explicit example of an agent querying order/tracking status after purchase, dedicated tracking-lookup tool documentation for the Store Sync/consumer commerce flow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this working end-to-end.
